statement:
∀ (m n : ℤ),
  ∫ (x : ℝ) in 0..2 * Real.pi, (starRingEnd ℂ) (Complex.exp (Complex.I * ↑m * ↑x)) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * ↑n * ↑x) =
    if m = n then ↑(2 * Real.pi) else 0

goal.text:
∫ (x : ℝ) in 0..2 * Real.pi, (starRingEnd ℂ) (Complex.exp (Complex.I * ↑m * ↑x)) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * ↑n * ↑x) =
  if m = n then ↑(2 * Real.pi) else 0
goal.rhs: if m = n then ↑(2 * Real.pi) else 0

atoms: if m = n then ↑(2 * Real.pi) else 0
